import sys, io, contextlib, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import planner as P
from scipy import sparse
A = sparse.csr_matrix(np.array([[-4.0],[0.0],[1.0]]))
b = np.array([0.0, 196608.0, 1.0])
E = sparse.csr_matrix(np.array([[0.0]])); d = np.array([4.0]); c = np.array([1.0])
import time
buf_out = io.StringIO(); buf_err = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf_out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(buf_err):
    t0=time.time()
    res = P._lp(c=c, A_ub=A, b_ub=b, A_eq=E, b_eq=d, bounds=(0,None), method="highs-ipm",
                options={"presolve": False})
    dt=time.time()-t0
print("status", res.status, "time %.2f"%dt)
print("stdout pollution:", repr(buf_out.getvalue())[:200])
print("stderr pollution:", repr(buf_err.getvalue())[:200])
EOF
